### `shopping_mall_channels`

Channels represent the main entry points or marketplaces within the
e-commerce platform.

Each channel defines its unique code and display name, enabling clear
identification and management within the system.

Channels serve as organizational units that link to specific sections and
categories to structure the shopping experience.

Soft deletion is supported to retain historical records while allowing
content moderation and administrative control.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Unique code identifying the channel, used for internal system references
  > and API routing.
- `name`: Display name of the channel as presented to customers and administrators.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the channel record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the channel record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the channel record was soft deleted; null if active.

### `shopping_mall_sections`

Sections represent subdivisions or areas within a channel that group
related categories and products.

Each section belongs to a single channel and serves to organize offerings
logically for improved navigation and management.

Sections have unique codes within the system and support soft deletion
for administrative purposes.

They track creation and update timestamps to support auditing and
operational history.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_channel_id`
  > Reference to the channel to which this section belongs. {@link
  > shopping_mall_channels.id}.
- `code`: Unique code identifying the section for internal use and API access.
- `name`
  > Display name of the section to show in the administrative interfaces and
  > to customers.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the section was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the section was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null when the section is active.

### `shopping_mall_channel_categories`

Channel categories link specific categories to channels, defining the
category organization within a particular channel context.

Each category linked to a channel may influence navigation, filtering,
and presentation of products within that channel.

This table supports soft deletion to allow removal without losing
historical relationships.

Timestamps track creation and update events for audit trails and system
operations.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_channel_id`: Reference to the shopping mall channel. [shopping_mall_channels.id](#shopping_mall_channels).
- `shopping_mall_product_category_id`
  > Reference to product category associated with this channel category.
  > [shopping_mall_product_categories.id](#shopping_mall_product_categories).
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the channel category record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update to this record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

### `shopping_mall_configurations`

Configurations store key-value pairs representing system-wide settings
and preferences.

Each configuration entry has a unique key to prevent duplicates and
ensure unambiguous retrieval.

Configurations can be soft deleted to allow deactivation without data loss.

Timestamps for creation and updates are maintained for auditing and
change tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `key`: Unique identifier key for the configuration setting.
- `value`: Configuration value as a string. Interpretation is context-dependent.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null when configuration is active.

### `shopping_mall_guests`

Guest users who browse the platform without requiring authentication.

They have a minimal profile and are tracked primarily for session
management and audit purposes.

Guest entities do not have login credentials and are intended for
transient or anonymous usage.

Soft deletion is supported to allow recording of guest removal without
losing historic session data.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the guest record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_guest_sessions`

Session records for guest users.

These track individual guest sessions including connection context such
as IP address, referrer, and connection URL.

Sessions allow monitoring guest activity anonymously.

Sessions have a foreign key reference to the guest user.

Session expiry information is recorded for session lifecycle management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_guest_id`: Reference to the guest user. [shopping_mall_guests.id](#shopping_mall_guests).
- `ip`: IP address of the guest session connection.
- `href`: URL of the connection origin.
- `referrer`: Referrer URL from which the guest arrived.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

### `shopping_mall_customers`

Registered customer users who have accounts to purchase products and
manage their profiles.

Customers can manage multiple shipping addresses, perform purchases,
submit reviews, and track order history.

Customer accounts include authentication credentials for login purposes.

Accounts support soft deletion for audit trails and historical integrity.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique email address for customer login and communication.
- `password_hash`: Hashed password for customer authentication.
- `name`: Customer's full name.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if account is active.

### `shopping_mall_customer_sessions`

Session records for authenticated customer users.

Each session tracks login information with IP, referrer, and connection URL.

Sessions help in managing multiple concurrent logins and auditing user
activity.

Sessions reference the customer user via a foreign key.

Session expiry supports session lifecycle management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Reference to the customer user. [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `ip`: IP address of the customer session connection.
- `href`: URL of the connection origin.
- `referrer`: Referrer URL from which the customer arrived.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

### `shopping_mall_sellers`

Seller users who manage product listings and inventory.

Sellers have authentication credentials for platform login and operation.

Accounts track statuses such as active or suspended to control
operational rights.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain historical data legally and
operationally.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique email address for seller login and communication.
- `password_hash`: Hashed password for seller authentication.
- `name`: Seller's registered business or personal name.
- `status`: Current status of the seller account (e.g., active, suspended).
- `business_status`: Business workflow status to track seller lifecycle.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the seller account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

### `shopping_mall_seller_sessions`

Session records for authenticated seller users.

Each session captures connection context for seller authentication and
activity tracking.

Sessions are linked to the corresponding seller user.

Expiration timestamps are used for session lifecycle management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`: Reference to the seller user. [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `ip`: IP address of the seller session connection.
- `href`: URL of the connection origin.
- `referrer`: Referrer URL from which the seller arrived.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

### `shopping_mall_admins`

Administrative users who manage the platform and oversee operational
aspects.

Admins have authentication credentials and full access rights.

Their accounts track lifecycle statuses and support soft deletion for
auditing.

Admin data supports enforcement of high-level access control policies.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique email address for admin login and communication.
- `password_hash`: Hashed password for admin authentication.
- `name`: Admin user's full name.
- `status`: Current status of the admin account (e.g., active, suspended).
- `business_status`: Business workflow status to track admin lifecycle.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the admin account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

### `shopping_mall_admin_sessions`

Session records for authenticated administrative users.

Sessions track login activity and connection details for administrators.

Foreign key references ensure session linkage to the admin account.

Expiration timestamps indicate session validity periods.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_admin_id`: Reference to the admin user. [shopping_mall_admins.id](#shopping_mall_admins).
- `ip`: IP address of the admin session connection.
- `href`: URL of the connection origin.
- `referrer`: Referrer URL from which the admin arrived.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

### `shopping_mall_products`

Products available in the shopping mall marketplace.

Represents the main catalog entries created and managed by sellers. Each
product belongs to one or more categories, supports multiple SKUs as
variants, and can be tracked through sales snapshots.

Includes essential metadata for display, grouping, and status management.
Products may be soft-deleted.

References seller entities and category relationship via foreign keys
from other components.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`
  > Reference to the seller entity who owns the product. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sellers.id}.
- `code`
  > Unique business code identifying the product, used in UI and backend
  > operations.
- `name`: Product name displayed to customers.
- `description`: Detailed product description.
- `is_active`: Indicates if the product is currently active and visible in the catalog.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the product was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the product was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp marking when the product was soft-deleted, if applicable.

### `shopping_mall_product_categories`

Product categories used to organize and classify products in the shopping
mall.

Supports hierarchical categorization for browsing and filtering.

Categories can have parent categories to form category trees.

Soft deletion is supported.

Primarily used to group products and facilitate search and navigation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_id`
  > Optional reference to the parent category for hierarchical
  > categorization. [shopping_mall_product_categories.id](#shopping_mall_product_categories).
- `name`: Category name displayed to users.
- `code`: Unique category code used in business operations.
- `description`: Detailed description of the category's purpose.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the category was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the category was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp marking when the category was soft-deleted.

### `shopping_mall_product_skus`

Stock Keeping Units representing specific variants of products.

Each SKU uniquely identifies a variant defined by a combination of
attribute values, price, and inventory quantity.

SKUs are directly linked to products and manage seller-specific pricing
and stock levels.

Supports soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_id`: Reference to the parent product. [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products).
- `sku_code`: Unique SKU code used for inventory and order processing.
- `price`: Sales price of this SKU variant.
- `inventory`: Current inventory count for the SKU.
- `is_active`: Indicates if the SKU is currently active and available for sale.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the SKU was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp marking when the SKU was soft-deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sku_attributes`

SKU attribute definitions representing types of variant attributes.

Defines attributes like color, size, material, etc., which can be used in
SKU options and values.

Attributes support soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

This supports extensible variant attribute management for products.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Name of the attribute type, e.g., 'Color' or 'Size'.
- `code`: Unique code of the attribute for system reference.
- `description`: Detailed explanation of the attribute's use cases.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the attribute was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the attribute was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the attribute was soft-deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values`

Individual values for SKU attributes.

Represents the selectable values for attribute types such as 'Red',
'Blue' for 'Color' or 'S', 'M', 'L' for 'Size'.

Links each value to an attribute and supports soft deletion and audit
timestamps.

Used to define variants in SKUs consistently.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sku_attribute_id`
  > Reference to the SKU attribute this value belongs to. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sku_attributes.id}.
- `value`: The specific value of the attribute, e.g., "Red", "XL".
- `code`: Unique code representing this attribute value.
- `description`: Additional details about this attribute value.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the value was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update to this value.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp marking the soft deletion of this attribute value.

### `shopping_mall_sku_option_groups`

Groups of SKU options that allow multiple selections under a variant.

Used to organize SKU options for complex variants with grouped choices.

Supports soft deletion and auditing timestamps.

Facilitates variant customization and pricing differentiation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.

timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_coupons`

Defines marketing coupons for the shopping mall platform.

Each coupon includes its unique code, discount information, validity
periods, and restrictions. Coupons are centrally managed to control
promotional offers and marketing campaigns.

This table stores raw coupon data without usage logs, supporting
creation, update, and deactivation. Soft deletion tracks removed coupons
while preserving history for auditing.

Uniqueness is enforced on coupon code for quick lookup during order
processing and validation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary key.
- `code`: Unique coupon code used by customers during checkout for discounts.
- `description`
  > Optional detailed description of the coupon's promotion and usage
  > conditions.
- `discount_type`: Type of discount applied by the coupon (e.g., percentage, fixed amount).
- `discount_value`
  > Value of the discount. Represents percentage or fixed amount depending on
  > discount type.
- `minimum_order_amount`: Optional minimum order amount required to apply this coupon.
- `maximum_discount_amount`: Optional cap on the maximum discount given by this coupon.
- `start_at`: Date and time when the coupon becomes valid and can be used.
- `end_at`: Date and time after which the coupon expires and cannot be used.
- `usage_limit`
  > Optional maximum number of total times this coupon can be redeemed across
  > all customers.
- `status`
  > Current status of the coupon, indicating if it is active, expired, or
  > disabled.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the coupon was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the coupon was last updated.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp to indicate logical deletion without physical
  > removal.

### `shopping_mall_coupon_redemptions`

Records each redemption of a coupon by a customer on an order.

Tracks which customer redeemed which coupon, tied to a specific order,
with timestamps and redeemed discount amount.

This table supports audit trails and prevents reuse where restrictions
apply. Logical deletion is supported for maintaining data integrity and
compliance.

Properties as follows:

- `shopping_mall_coupon_id`: Reference to the coupon being redeemed. [shopping_mall_coupons.id](#shopping_mall_coupons).

  > Reference to the customer redeeming the coupon. {@link
  > shopping_mall_customers.id}.
- `shopping_mall_order_id`
  > Reference to the order where the coupon was applied. {@link
  > shopping_mall_orders.id}.
- `redeemed_amount`: The actual discount amount applied during this redemption.
- `redeemed_at`: Timestamp when this coupon redemption occurred.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for logical removal of the redemption record.

### `shopping_mall_articles`

Articles posted in the shopping mall platform by registered users.

This model represents user-generated content allowing customers to
publish articles on various topics. Articles are organized by categories
and contain titles and text bodies.

Each article tracks creation, update, and soft deletion timestamps for
audit and moderation purposes.

Articles maintain relationships to customers and categories and support
moderation workflows through comment relationships.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`
  > Reference to the customer who authored the article. {@link
  > shopping_mall_customers.id}.
- `shopping_mall_article_category_id`
  > Reference to the category that the article belongs to. {@link
  > shopping_mall_article_categories.id}.
- `title`: The article's title summarizing the content.
- `body`: The main textual content of the article.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the article was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the article was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the article was soft-deleted; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_article_categories`

Hierarchical categories to organize articles within the shopping mall
platform.

Categories can have parent-child relationships enabling nested structures.
Each category has a unique name within the platform.

The model supports creation, update, and soft deletion timestamps for
lifecycle management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary key.
- `parent_id`
  > Optional reference to the parent category. {@link
  > shopping_mall_article_categories.id}.
- `name`: The category name, unique within the platform.
- `description`: Optional detailed description of the category.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the category was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the category was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_article_comments`

User comments on articles within the shopping mall platform.

Comments enable customer interaction on articles and support moderation
workflows.

Each comment is linked to a customer, an article, and a specific customer
session to track the origin.

Comments include content, creation, update, and soft deletion timestamps.

Moderation and searchability are supported through indexing on content
fields.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`
  > Reference to the customer who made the comment. {@link
  > shopping_mall_customers.id}.
- `shopping_mall_article_id`
  > Reference to the article being commented on. {@link
  > shopping_mall_articles.id}.
- `shopping_mall_customer_session_id`
  > Reference to the customer session during which the comment was made.
  > [shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id](#shopping_mall_customer_sessions).
- `body`: Comment textual content, supporting detailed feedback or discussion.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the comment was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the comment was soft-deleted, null if active.

operations.specification: This API operation allows guest users (unauthenticated users with access to browse products and perform searches) to register a temporary guest account and obtain temporary JWT tokens for session management. This is essential because guests do not have persistent accounts and need lightweight access credentials for browsing and limited actions.
operations.description:
This operation creates a new guest account. It issues temporary JWT tokens that enable guests to maintain session state without full membership. The schema for guests supports necessary fields to create and manage temporary guests. Guest users do not provide typical login credentials but receive a lightweight token for limited interaction.

Implementation relies on fields available in the guest schema for session identification and token issuance.

Guest users benefit from immediate access to browsing features with minimal authentication overhead.

Security is handled through token expiration and validation mechanisms appropriate for temporary access.

This operation works alongside refresh to maintain guest sessions without requiring full re-registration.

The response returns an IShoppingMallCustomer.IAuthorized type containing the authorization tokens and basic user info.

limit.description: Limitation of records per a page.

pages.description:
Total pages.

Equal to {@link records} / {@link limit} with ceiling.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

IAuthorizationToken.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.

IShoppingMallGuest.IJoin.description: Guest user self-registration request schema. Allows guests to register temporary accounts with minimal information to obtain JWT tokens for browsing with limited access rights.

name.description: Guest's display name or nickname for identification during the session. Not unique and can be changed by the guest.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR).

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) provided by the client. Mandatory for session creation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) provided by the client. Mandatory for session creation.

IShoppingMallGuest.IAuthorized.description: Response schema for authorized guest users containing unique identifier and JWT token information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated guest user.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token previously issued to the guest user for obtaining new access tokens.

IShoppingMallGuest.IRefresh.description: Request payload for refreshing a guest user's JWT tokens.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ICreate.description:
Request payload to create a new registered customer account in the shopping mall system.

Includes customer's unique email, plain text password for authentication, full name, and session context details.

Sensitive fields like ID and timestamps are managed automatically by the system and excluded here. Password is expected in plain text and will be hashed server-side.

email.description: Unique email address of the customer used for login and communication.

password.description: Plain text password for customer authentication. The backend will hash this password securely.

full_name.description: Full name of the customer for profile and billing purposes.

ip.description: Optional IP address of the client connection. This is used for session auditing and analysis. The server can extract this when not provided by the client.

href.description: The URL of the webpage where the customer signed up. This is required for creating the session record and auditing purposes.

referrer.description: The URL of the referrer page before the customer sign-up page. This is required for creating the session record and auditing purposes.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IAuthorized.description: Authorized customer information containing JWT tokens and basic user profile following successful authentication or registration.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated customer.

name.description: Full name of the customer.

phone_number.description: Contact phone number of the customer, nullable if not provided.

status.description: Account status, e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated. Nullable if never updated.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ILogin.description: Request body for customer login including email, password, and session context for auditing.

email.description: Customer email address used for login.

password.description: Customer password in plain text for verification.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (optional - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR).

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - mandatory for session creation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - mandatory for session creation.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRefresh.description: Request body containing the refresh token needed for session continuation by an authenticated customer.

refresh_token.description: Valid refresh token previously issued to the customer for authentication session continuity.

IShoppingMallSeller.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new seller account. Contains necessary fields to register as a seller in the marketplace system. Authentication fields like password are provided as plain text and will be securely hashed before storage.

email.description: Unique email address used for seller account login and communications.

password.description: Plain text password for the seller account. The server hashes this before storing in password_hash.

name.description: Name of the seller or seller company.

email.description: Email address of the seller for login and contact.

name.description: Full name or business name of the seller.

oneOf.description: Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).
Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).
Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).

status.description: Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).

oneOf.description: Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).
Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).
Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the seller account.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp of soft deletion, if the seller account has been deleted.

IShoppingMallSeller.ILogin.description: Credentials required for seller login, including email and password. Also includes session context fields necessary for connection metadata required at login for security and auditing.

email.description: Seller's registered email address used for login.

password.description: Plain text password for authentication verification.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (optional; server can extract but client may provide for SSR).

href.description: Current page URL representing connection endpoint; mandatory for session context.

referrer.description: Referrer URL representing previous page URL; mandatory for session context.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRefresh.description: Refresh token information for seller users to obtain new JWT tokens without logging in again. Contains the refresh token string issued during login or previous refresh operations.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token string provided by the client to authenticate and renew the session. Must be a valid UUID string.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new admin user in the shopping mall platform.

Includes mandatory user profile information, authentication credentials, and role assignment.
Admin creation validates uniqueness of email and safely stores hashed passwords.
Roles dictate the scope of administrative privileges granted upon account creation.

email.description: Unique email address used for login and communication with the new admin user. Must be a valid, non-personal business email compliant with RFC 5322.

name.description: Full name of the admin user as it appears in administrative interfaces and audit logs.

password.description: Password in plain text upon creation, which will be securely hashed by backend services before storage. Must meet complexity requirements including minimum length and character variety.

oneOf.description: Optional contact phone number for the admin user for multi-factor authentication or support purposes.

phone_number.description: Optional contact phone number for the admin user for multi-factor authentication or support purposes.

oneOf.description: Administrator with full access across all platform areas and capabilities.
Administrator with moderate access for daily management tasks.
Administrator focused on customer support functions and limited management permissions.

role.description: Assigned admin role determining permissions and responsibilities on the platform.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IAuthorized.description:
Authorization token response after successful admin authentication or registration.

Contains unique identifier and JWT token information enabling secure platform access for admin actors.

The id property represents the unique UUID of the admin user.
The token property includes the JWT token details used for session authentication and authorization.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated admin user

name.description: Full name of the admin user.

role.description: Role assigned to the admin user.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the admin user account is active.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the admin user account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the admin user account was last updated.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ILogin.description:
Login credentials for admin user authentication.

Includes the email and password used to authenticate and obtain authorization tokens.

Request schema for the /auth/admin/login endpoint.

Password field is plain-text; the backend hashes the password before storing or comparing.

email.description: Admin user email address used for login and communication

password.description: Admin user password in plain text for authentication

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR)

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY for session context

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY for session context

IShoppingMallGuest.IRequest.description:
Filter parameters for searching and paginating shopping mall guest users.

This schema defines the possible query filters, pagination controls, and sorting options for requesting a paged list of guest users in the shopping mall platform.
These parameters allow rich search scenarios including filtering by guest ID, creation or update timestamps, and soft deletion status.

Fields correspond to the columns and attributes available in the `shopping_mall_guests` Prisma table for precise filtering.

page.description: The current page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: The maximum number of records returned per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

search.description: A text search string to match against guest users' identifying attributes.

created_at_from.description: Filter guests created after this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_at_to.description: Filter guests created before this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_from.description: Filter guests updated after this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_to.description: Filter guests updated before this timestamp (inclusive). Must be ISO 8601 date-time format.

deleted_at_is_null.description: Filter by soft deletion status. When true, returns only guests who are not soft-deleted (deleted_at is null). When false, includes soft-deleted guests.

IShoppingMallGuest.description:
Guest users who browse the platform without requiring authentication.

They have a minimal profile and are tracked primarily for session management and audit purposes.

Guest entities do not have login credentials and are intended for transient or anonymous usage.

Soft deletion is supported to allow recording of guest removal without losing historic session data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user. Generated as a UUID.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallGuest.ICreate.description:
Create schema for Guest users who browse without full authentication.

Allows creating a guest user with session and device metadata to support partial access and customized visitor experience.

Excludes any authentication fields since guests are unauthenticated users.

device_info.description: Additional information about the device or browser used by the guest.

oneOf.description: IP address of the guest; optional but helpful for logging and security.

ip_address.description: IP address of the guest; optional but helpful for logging and security.

session_id.description: Session identifier for tracking guest session continuity.

IShoppingMallGuest.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for existing guest users to modify mutable fields such as session expiration or last activity.

Does not allow change of unique identifier or creation-time fields.

Supports partial updates by making all fields optional.

device_info.description: Updates to device information about the guest's session.

oneOf.description: Updated IP address of the guest if it has changed.

ip_address.description: Updated IP address of the guest if it has changed.

session_id.description: Session identifier to maintain continuity for the guest user.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.ICreate.description: Input schema for creating a new guest session record representing connection context and activity details of a guest user in the shopping mall platform.

ip.description: IP address of the client initiating the session. Allows tracking of the geographical source of the connection. Optional if the server captures it from the request context.

href.description: The current page URL from which the guest connects. This helps identify the exact location where the session was initiated.

referrer.description: The URL of the referring page leading the guest to the current page. Useful for traffic source analysis and referral tracking.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.IUpdate.description: Input schema for updating guest session records with modifiable properties such as session expiration, activity timestamps, device info, or status flags.

oneOf.description: The last known IP address before the session expired. It may be null if not applicable.

expiredIp.description: The last known IP address before the session expired. It may be null if not applicable.

oneOf.description: Last active URL before the session expired. Can be null if session did not properly record it.

expiredHref.description: Last active URL before the session expired. Can be null if session did not properly record it.

oneOf.description: Last referrer URL before the session closed or expired. May be null when unknown.

expiredReferrer.description: Last referrer URL before the session closed or expired. May be null when unknown.

oneOf.description: Timestamp noting when this session expired or ended. Null indicates an active session.

expiredTime.description: Timestamp noting when this session expired or ended. Null indicates an active session.

oneOf.description: Current page URL associated with the session. May be null if not updated.

href.description: Current page URL associated with the session. May be null if not updated.

oneOf.description: IP address for the session. Nullable to allow clearing or non-provision if out of date.

ip.description: IP address for the session. Nullable to allow clearing or non-provision if out of date.

oneOf.description: Referrer URL for the session. May be null if not present or cleared.

referrer.description: Referrer URL for the session. May be null if not present or cleared.

page.description: Page number for pagination, must be a positive integer starting from 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Limits prevent performance issues.

search.description: Optional search string to filter customers by name or email.

status.description: Optional status filter to include customers with specific account statuses.

sort_by.description: Optional field to sort the customer list by, e.g., 'created_at', 'email'.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering customers

IShoppingMallCustomer.description:
Represents a registered customer in the shopping mall platform.

Contains profile information and system metadata for active customers.

Timestamps `created_at` and `updated_at` track record lifecycle; `deleted_at` support soft deletion.

Sensitive fields like hashed passwords are removed from responses to prevent sensitive data exposure.

This object is used in response payloads and detailed customer queries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

email.description: Customer's unique email address used for login.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last update of customer information.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion; null if active.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IUpdate.description: Schema for partial updating mutable customer profile fields in the shopping mall platform. Immutable fields like customer ID and authentication context are excluded. This schema allows updating of fields that are mutable in the customer record. System-managed timestamps like 'updated_at' and 'deleted_at' are removed to protect integrity.

email.description: Unique email address used for customer login and communication. Must be a valid email.

name.description: Customer's full name as registered in their profile.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.IRequest.description: Request schema for filtering and paginating customer session records in the shopping mall admin APIs.

page.description: Page number, must be one or higher.

limit.description: Number of records per page, maximum 100.

search_term.description: Search term for filtering sessions by user agent or IP address.

oneOf.description: Field to sort session records by.
Field to sort session records by.

sort_by.description: Field to sort session records by.

oneOf.description: Sorting order: ascending or descending.
Sorting order: ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.description:
Authenticated customer session record associated with a registered customer user in the shopping mall platform.

Stores session metadata such as IP address, connection URL, referrer URL, timestamps, and activity status.

This schema maps to the shopping_mall_customer_sessions table in the Prisma database.

All sensitive authentication fields are managed by the server; clients only provide connection metadata during session creation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer session record.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the registered customer user to whom this session belongs.

ip.description: IP address of the client associated with this session. Optional; server may extract automatically, but client can provide for SSR scenarios.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL). Provided by client; mandatory for session tracking and auditing.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL). Provided by client; mandatory for session tracking and auditing.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this session was created. Managed by system.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when this session is set to expire or be invalidated.

last_active_at.description: Timestamp when the session was last active. Null if unknown.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ICreate.description:
Payload to create a new authenticated customer session record.

Clients must provide connection metadata such as IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL.

This schema maps to the shopping_mall_customer_sessions table in the Prisma database.

ip.description: IP address of the client for the session. Optional but recommended for auditing.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) for session tracking. Required.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) for session tracking. Required.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.IUpdate.description:
Update payload for modifying existing shopping mall customer session records.

This schema defines the allowable fields that can be updated for customer sessions including connection metadata such as IP address, origin URL, referrer URL, and expiration timestamp.

This schema excludes immutable properties such as primary keys and creation timestamps, ensuring only mutable session metadata is updated.

ip.description: IP address of the customer session connection. This field is expected to conform to IPv4 or IPv6 address formats and is used for logging and auditing purposes.

href.description: URL of the connection origin. This is the full URL string representing the client's current page when the session was created or updated. It is crucial for tracking the source of traffic and session origin.

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the customer arrived. This field captures the previous page URL, providing context for user navigation and traffic analysis.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active. A null value indicates the session is currently active and has not expired.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

search.description: Search keyword to filter seller accounts by name or email address.

oneOf.description: Filters sellers by their account status, such as active or suspended.

status.description: Filters sellers by their account status, such as active or suspended.

oneOf.description: Filters sellers by their business lifecycle status, providing stages like pending approval, active, or deactivated.

business_status.description: Filters sellers by their business lifecycle status, providing stages like pending approval, active, or deactivated.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating seller accounts in the shopping mall.

Supports filtering by name and email, as well as pagination controls.

Optional filtering by seller status and business lifecycle status is also supported.

This schema is used as the request body for the seller list query operation.

IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.description:
Summary information about a seller in the shopping mall marketplace.

Provides an overview of the seller's identity, status, and key attributes used for list views and references.

Excludes sensitive authentication fields and session information.

The summary includes the seller's unique ID, official name, email contact, current status, business approval status, timestamps for creation, updates, and optional deletion timestamp.

Used primarily in collections and references from related entities where detailed seller data is not required.

id.description: Unique identifier of the seller

name.description: Official name of the seller

email.description: Contact email address of the seller

oneOf.description: The seller account is active and can operate normally.
The seller account is inactive and cannot operate until reactivated.
The seller account is suspended due to violations or policy issues.

status.description: Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).

oneOf.description: The seller business has been approved and is authorized to sell.
The seller business approval is pending and under review.
The seller business has been rejected and is not authorized to sell.

business_status.description: Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the seller account

deleted_at.description: Timestamp of soft deletion, if the seller account has been deleted.

IShoppingMallSeller.description:
Represents a seller user account in the shopping mall platform.

Includes essential information such as the seller's email, name, business status, account status, and audit timestamps. Password hash is excluded to maintain security.

This schema serves as the detailed response representation for seller entities, providing all publicly visible properties except sensitive authentication data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller user.

email.description: Email address of the seller for login and contact.

name.description: Full name or business name of the seller.

oneOf.description: Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).
Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).
Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).

status.description: Current status of the seller account (active, inactive, suspended).

oneOf.description: Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).
Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).
Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).

business_status.description: Business approval status of the seller (approved, pending, rejected).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the seller account.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp of soft deletion, if the seller account has been deleted.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating existing seller user information.

Allows modification of mutable fields such as the seller's name, status, and business approval status. Password hash updates are disallowed from the client-side for security.

Timestamps are system managed and are not directly updated via this schema.

name.description: Full name or business name of the seller.

oneOf.description: Updated status of the seller account.
Updated status of the seller account.
Updated status of the seller account.

status.description: Updated status of the seller account.

oneOf.description: Updated business approval status for the seller.
Updated business approval status for the seller.
Updated business approval status for the seller.

business_status.description: Updated business approval status for the seller.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating seller sessions.

Supports filtering by IP, connection URLs, or date ranges, and controls pagination defaults and limits.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page, capped at 100 to prevent excessive load.

oneOf.description: Optional search keyword to filter sessions by IP, href, or referrer fields.

search.description: Optional search keyword to filter sessions by IP, href, or referrer fields.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.description:
Represents a session record for a seller user in the shopping mall platform.

Tracks connection context such as IP address, connection URLs, referrer URLs, creation and expiration timestamps.

This record helps in managing and auditing seller sessions and activity history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller session.

seller_id.description: Unique identifier of the seller user this session belongs to.

ip.description: IP address of the connection origin. Optional and may be null if unknown.

href.description: The URL of the page from which the session originated. Typically the page the user was visiting.

referrer.description: The URL of the previous page leading to this session. May be empty if direct access.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when this session expires or will be invalidated. Null if session does not expire.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a new seller session in the shopping mall system.

This object defines all necessary properties for inserting a new session record associated with a seller user. It includes metadata such as IP address, connection URL, referrer, user agent, and expiration timestamps for auditing.

The authenticated seller is inferred from the context and not included in the request body.

ip.description: The IP address from which the session is initiated. Optional, accepts null if unknown or unavailable.

href.description: The full URL of the page where the session was started. This must be provided by the client to help track session origins.

referrer.description: The referring URL prior to arriving at the current page. Helps trace navigation paths leading to the session. Required for session analysis.

userAgent.description: The user-agent string identifying the browser or client software. Optional, may be null if not provided.

expiresAt.description: The expiration timestamp of the session. Optional but useful for session lifecycle management.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.IUpdate.description:
Data structure for updating a seller session record with mutable session details such as last activity time, session expiration, and status flags.

This DTO is used when an authenticated seller updates his session information to refresh session timestamps or to change session validity.

Security Note: Seller identity is validated via authentication context and not provided in this DTO.

oneOf.description: Timestamp of the seller's last interaction within the session. Used to track activity and session validity.

IShoppingMallAdmin.description:
Detailed information about a shopping mall administrative user.

Represents an administrator account with full or limited access to the e-commerce platform management features.
Admins have credentials and roles defining their permissions and activity status.
Timestamps track lifecycle events for the admin account creation and updates.

id.description: A unique identifier for the administrative user, generated as a UUID string ensuring global uniqueness across the platform.

email.description: The email address for the admin used in system login and notifications. Must be unique and conform to RFC 5322 standards.

name.description: The full name of the admin user used throughout the platform for display and identification.

role.description: Role defining the administrative user's permissions and access levels within the platform. Must be one of 'superadmin', 'admin', or 'support'.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the admin user account is currently active and allowed to access the system features.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the admin user account was originally created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp marking the most recent update to the admin user account. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating shopping mall admin user information.

All properties are optional allowing partial updates.
Fields include contact updates, avatar changes, and activation status toggling.
Immutable fields such as ID are excluded from this DTO to prevent accidental changes.

name.description: Updated full name of the admin user for display purposes.

email.description: Updated email address used for login and notifications. Changing this requires verification processes.

phone_number.description: Updated contact phone number for the admin user, used for multi-factor authentication or urgent notifications.

avatar_url.description: URL link to an administrative user's avatar image, supporting optional profile pictures. Can be set to null to remove existing avatar.

is_active.description: Flag to enable or disable the admin user account within the management system. Disabled accounts cannot log in.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.description:
Detailed information about a specific admin session associated with an admin user in the shopping mall system.

Sensitive session tokens such as JWT tokens are not exposed in this response schema to safeguard security and privacy.

id.description: Unique identifier of the admin session.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin session originated.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the admin's browser or client.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the admin session was created.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the session will expire. Null indicates no expiration.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the admin session is currently active.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new admin session record in the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

Contains session token, login context, and metadata required for secure session establishment by authenticated admin users.

The admin_id field is excluded from request payload because it comes from the authenticated admin context and as it's a path parameter to avoid security breach and duplication.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin logged in. Nullable for some network conditions

user_agent.description: User agent string of the admin's browser or client application

IShoppingMallAdminSession.IUpdate.description:
Payload schema for updating an existing admin session record in the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

Allows modification of session status, expiration, and metadata by authorized admin users.

Does not allow changing the primary key fields such as admin_id or session id.

login_user_agent.description: Updated user agent string for the session

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a shopping mall channel category.

Contains the properties required to link an existing product category to a specific shopping mall channel.
This operation requires admin authorization and uses the shopping mall channel code as path parameter to resolve the channel context.

Auto-generated fields and system-managed timestamps are excluded from this creation request.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the channel category association is active

display_order.description: Order in which the channel category is displayed relative to others in this channel

oneOf.description: Optional notes or comments about the channel category association

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the channel category association

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.description:
Detailed shopping mall channel category information.

Represents a specific category that is linked to a particular shopping mall channel, defining its position and role within the channel's categorization hierarchy.

Includes identification properties, references to the channel and product category it belongs to, ordering information, timestamps for auditing, and soft deletion status.

shopping_mall_product_category_code.description: Unique business code of the linked shopping mall product category

name.description: Human-readable name of this channel category

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the record was soft deleted, or null if not deleted

is_visible.description: Flag indicating whether the category is publicly visible to customers

max_virtual_products_per_order.description: Maximum number of virtual products allowed in a single order for this category

memo2.description: Additional memo or notes associated with this category

marketing_comment.description: Marketing comments to promote the category

statistics_count.description: Count of statistics related to this category

statistics_last_updated_at.description: Last time statistics were updated for the category

external_link_url.description: External URL for redirecting consumers, if applicable

use_ADS.description: Flag indicating whether to use advertisements for this category

ad_display_start_at.description: Datetime when advertisement display starts for this category

ad_display_end_at.description: Datetime when advertisement display ends for this category

additional_flags.description: Miscellaneous flags in string format for future extension

tags.description: List of tags associated with this category

IShoppingMallChannelCategory.IUpdate.description:
Request schema to update an existing shopping mall channel category. This allows admins to modify the details and association of a product category linked to a specific shopping mall channel.

The update schema includes fields that exist in the Prisma model `shopping_mall_channel_categories` and excludes any phantom properties.

Properties include all mutable fields such as association IDs, display order, notes, and active status, but excludes immutable system-managed fields.

The schema aligns exactly with the Prisma model fields to prevent phantom field errors.

Configuration setting in the shopping mall system, representing a unique key-value pair controlling system-wide preferences, feature toggles, and operational parameters.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new shopping mall product.

This creation schema excludes system-managed and authentication context fields such as `shopping_mall_seller_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, and `deleted_at`.

Includes fields for the product code, product name, optional description, and active status flag.

Used in API operations allowing authorized sellers or admins to create products without the ability to override authentication context.

code.description: Unique business code for the product used as a global identifier required during creation.

name.description: The official name of the product to be displayed in the shopping mall catalog.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the product. Can be null if no description is provided.

is_active.description: Flag to set whether the product is active and visible after creation.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Represents detailed information of a shopping mall product entity used in customer and guest views.

This schema provides comprehensive details for an individual product identified uniquely by its globally unique productCode.
It includes fundamental product metadata such as code, name, description, activity status, and timestamp fields marking creation, updates, and soft deletion.

Associations to sellers or categories are available through related schemas rather than direct FK fields to prevent security risks and data exposure.

This schema ensures full representation of the product entity fields fetched in a read operation, serving as the response body for product detail retrieval API endpoints.

code.description: Unique business code identifying the product, used globally as an identifier for this shopping mall product.

name.description: Human-readable name of the product displayed to customers.

description.description: Detailed description of the product, can be null if not provided.

is_active.description: Flag indicating whether the product is active and visible within the shopping mall catalog.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the product was initially created in the system.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the last time the product details were updated.

deleted_at.description: Nullable ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the product was soft deleted, if applicable.

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description:
Represents the payload used to update an existing product in the shopping mall catalog.

This schema includes properties that can be modified by authorized users to keep product details current.

Fields such as product name, description, and activity status can be updated.

Ownership and creation timestamps are immutable and thus excluded from this schema.

The schema enforces constraints ensuring valid updates in line with business rules and database integrity.

This type supports partial updates, allowing users to modify specific fields without affecting others.

name.description: Product name displayed to customers and used in listings.

description.description: Detailed product description providing in-depth information for customers and administrators. May be set to null to remove the existing description.

is_active.description: Indicates if the product is currently active and visible in the catalog. Active products are considered available for sale.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page.

search.description: Search keyword to filter SKUs by code or description.

sort_by.description: Field to sort SKUs by. Example values: 'price', 'inventory', 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).
Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

is_active.description: Filter SKUs by active status. True to include only active SKUs.

IShoppingMallProductSku.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) variant under a specific product in the shopping mall platform.

Represents the input data required to define a unique SKU variant associated with an existing product, including SKU code, price, inventory quantity, and active status.

Security: The seller's identity is derived from the authenticated context and must not be included here.

sku_code.description: Unique SKU code used for inventory and order processing. Must be unique across all SKUs for the product and follow the platform's SKU format guidelines.

price.description: Sales price of this SKU variant in the store's currency. Must be a non-negative number representing the selling price.

inventory.description: Current stock inventory count available for this SKU variant. Must be a non-negative integer reflecting physical inventory.

is_active.description: Indicates whether this SKU is active and available for sale. True means the SKU is available; false means it is inactive or discontinued.

IShoppingMallProductSku.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating existing product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the shopping mall platform.

Allows modification of SKU details including pricing, stock levels, variant attributes, and activation status.

Authorization: Only authenticated sellers who own the product can update its SKUs.

Excludes seller identity fields as they are injected from authentication context.

price.description: Sale price of the SKU in USD. Must be non-negative.

inventory.description: Available stock quantity for the SKU. Must be zero or positive.

is_active.description: Activation status indicating whether the SKU is currently available for sale.

name.description: Unique SKU code identifier for this product variant. Maximum 50 characters.

IShoppingMallProductCategory.description:
Represents a shopping mall product category entity.

Describes the properties of a product category used for classification of products in the shopping mall. Each category has a unique code and descriptive name. Categories may have hierarchical relationships managed through other operations.

This includes audit fields for creation and update timestamps.

Sensitive fields and ownership references are omitted for security and design consistency.

Soft deletion can be performed by setting the 'deleted_at' field.

All properties are optional to allow flexibility in updates.

IShoppingMallShoppingCart.description:
Detailed information about a shopping cart in the shopping mall platform.

Represents a customer's shopping cart including session details and references to customer information as well as cart items if applicable.

This object reflects the shopping_mall_shopping_carts table from the Prisma schema and includes necessary metadata for client and backend processing.

Sensitive details are omitted. Ownership fields come from the authenticated customer's session context and are therefore excluded from direct input.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping cart.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer who owns this shopping cart.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the session associated with this shopping cart if applicable, null if not linked to a session.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session associated with this shopping cart if applicable, null if not linked to a session.

status.description: Status of the shopping cart indicating whether it is active or inactive or other business-defined states.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was last updated.

IShoppingMallShoppingCart.ICreate.description:
Shopping cart creation payload for the authenticated customer.

This schema defines the structure of data required to create a new shopping cart, including optional initial items. Fields related to ownership are managed by the authentication context and thus are excluded from this schema.

Compositional relations such as cart items are included as nested create objects to enable atomic creation of the entire cart and its contents.

items.description: Optional array of items to include in the shopping cart upon creation.

IShoppingMallShoppingCart.IUpdate.description:
Request payload to update shopping cart fields excluding the cart identifier.

Allows modification of shopping cart session association and timestamps by the authenticated customer. Ownership fields are excluded.

All properties are optional to enable partial updates.

session_expired_at.description:
Optional expiration datetime of the shopping cart session in ISO 8601 format with date-time.

Null value indicates no expiration.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating shopping cart items within a customer's shopping cart.

This DTO allows clients to specify filters, sorting, and pagination options when retrieving shopping cart items associated with a particular shopping cart. It supports searching by product identifiers, SKU codes, and quantity ranges.

The parameters facilitate efficient querying and result narrowing for enhanced user experience in shopping cart management.

This schema corresponds to the shopping_mall_cart_items Prisma table DTO for search requests.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page, maximum 100.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction: ascending or descending.
Sort order direction: ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallWishlist.description:
Represents a customer's wishlist in the shopping mall platform, containing saved products for future purchase.

Includes fields for identification, ownership, status, and timestamps for tracking creation and modification.

Used to organize products a customer intends to buy later.

id.description: Unique identifier of the wishlist.

customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer owning the wishlist.

name.description: Name of the wishlist to distinguish between multiple wishlists for a customer.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the wishlist.

IShoppingMallWishlist.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new customer wishlist in the shopping mall platform.

Represents the essential information needed from clients to create a wishlist that the customer will own.
Excludes system-generated fields such as unique identifiers and timestamps.
Ensures secure creation tied to authenticated customer's context.
Use this DTO when customers want to save a list of desired products for future purchases.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for wishlist items.

Supports filtering, sorting, and paginated retrieval of wishlist items based on customer and wishlist context.

page.description: The page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page in the paginated results.

search.description: Search keyword to filter wishlist items by product name or description.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.description:
Represents an item saved by a customer in their wishlist within the shopping mall platform.

Each wishlist item references a specific product and includes details such as quantity and attributes relevant for the customer’s future purchase intent.

This schema is used in responses for retrieving detailed wishlist item information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the wishlist item

wishlist_id.description: Identifier of the wishlist this item belongs to

product_id.description: Identifier of the product added to the wishlist

options.description: Selected product options for this wishlist item

created_at.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the item was last updated

product.description: Summary information of the product added to the wishlist item

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ICreate.description:

Used in requests to add items to a customer's wishlist.

Includes modifiable fields such as quantity and any mutable product attributes relevant in the wishlist context. The customer identity is inferred from the authenticated user context and is not included as a field here.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Represents an individual order placed by a customer in the e-commerce shopping mall system.

This schema corresponds to the `shopping_mall_orders` database model, which tracks order metadata, customer reference, status, payment information, and lifecycle timestamps. Soft deletion is supported via the optional `deleted_at` field.

The object includes associations, but actor-based fields (such as customer ID from JWT) are excluded from request DTOs and handled by the authentication system.

Used in responses to provide full order details.

id.description: Unique identifier of the order as primary key.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order.

order_number.description: Unique business order number used for external references.

status.description: Current status of the order, such as `pending`, `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or `cancelled`.

payment_status.description: Current payment status for the order indicating if payment is pending, completed, or failed.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount for the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the order was initially created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Optional soft deletion timestamp indicating when the order was logically deleted.

order_number.description: Unique business order number for external reference.

status.description: Current order status such as pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

payment_status.description: Payment status indicating whether payment is pending, completed, or failed.

total_amount.description: Total amount of the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Request body DTO for creating a new shopping mall order.

Contains the necessary information to create the order excluding the primary key, timestamps, and customer ID which is inferred from the authenticated customer context.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description:
Data transfer object for updating an existing shopping mall order.

Allows modification of order status, payment status, total amount, and timestamps that reflect order lifecycle changes. Ownership and customer reference fields are excluded as they are immutable or managed via authentication context.

Timestamps like `created_at` are managed by the system and cannot be changed via this DTO.

All fields are optional, allowing partial updates.

order_number.description: Unique business order number for external reference. Typically immutable and not meant to be changed by this DTO but included for completeness.

status.description: Current order status indicating stage in the order lifecycle such as pending, processing, shipped, delivered, or cancelled.

payment_status.description: Payment status showing if payment has been completed, is pending, or has failed.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount of the order including taxes, fees, and discounts.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated, reflecting status or details changes.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating if the order has been logically deleted. Null means active. This field is managed by the system or admin processes.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IRequest.description:
Search and filter parameters for retrieving paginated order items within a specific shopping mall order.

This request schema enables filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities for order items related to a given order. It is used primarily by customers to efficiently query and navigate the detailed SKUs within their orders.

All parameters map to corresponding fields in the shopping_mall_order_items table and support standard query operations for item status, quantities, and date ranges.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page.

search.description: Optional free-text search string to filter order items.

Represents all required data to add a product SKU with specified quantity and initial unit price to the specified order, complying with business validation rules including inventory availability and pricing.

product_sku_id.description: SKU identifier of the product being added to the order. This must be a valid UUID referencing an existing product SKU in inventory.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product to add to the order. Must be a positive integer representing how many units the customer wants to purchase.

unit_price.description: Unit price for the order item at the time of addition. Must be a non-negative number representing the price per unit in the appropriate currency.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Individual items included in customer orders in the shopping mall platform.

This entity represents each SKU included in an order, specifying the quantity, unit price at order time, and current status of the order item.

It includes references to the parent shopping mall order and the specific product SKU. It tracks creation and update timestamps for auditing and order lifecycle management.

id.description: Primary key unique identifier for the order item.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Reference to the parent shopping mall order's unique identifier.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the product SKU included in the order.

quantity.description: The number of units of the SKU ordered in this order item. Must be a positive integer.

unit_price.description: Unit price of one SKU unit at the time the order was placed, represented as a double precision floating point number.

status.description: Current status of the order item, such as pending, shipped, or returned. Values should correspond to the business workflow and status definitions.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp indicating when this order item record was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp indicating the last time this order item record was updated.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing shopping mall order item record.

Allows changes to the quantity, unit price, and status fields of an existing order item. This DTO excludes immutable fields such as identifiers and timestamps.

Designed for PATCH or PUT requests, all properties are optional to allow partial updates.

quantity.description: Updated quantity of the SKU units included in this order item.

unit_price.description: Updated unit price for the SKU units at the time of order modification.

status.description: Updated status of the order item, reflecting workflow progress such as processing, shipped, returned, or cancelled.

IShoppingMallPayment.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new payment record in the shopping mall platform.

Includes required payment details like order association, method, amount, and status.

Optional fields allow for soft deletion and setting update timestamps if necessary.

`transaction_id` is optional and can be provided if available.

This schema corresponds directly to the shopping_mall_payments Prisma model.

payment_method.description: The method used for the payment transaction, such as credit card, bank transfer, or digital wallet.

amount.description: The amount paid in this payment transaction, represented in the system's currency.
